# StudentDocs Merge PDF Online

> Free, 100% private, client-side PDF merger for students, colleges, and job applications.

## Capabilities
- Combines two or more PDF files into a single, organized PDF document.
- Client-side execution using pdf-lib: zero server uploads, 100% local memory processing.
- Re-order files via Up/Down buttons, inspect page counts, and download instantly.
- Built specifically for student assignments, Aadhaar front/back PDF joining, and administrative documents.

## Core URLs
- Application Home: https://merge-pdf.vercel.app/
- Sitemap: https://merge-pdf.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
